description: Client-side script for the 'Student Group' doctype in ERPNext, managing form behaviors, queries, buttons, and related actions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets query for academic term and student list, triggered on form load.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Adds custom action buttons for email, attendance, scheduling, and newsletter when form is not new.

methods.name: group_based_on
methods.description: Adjusts form fields based on grouping criteria (Batch, Course, Activity).

methods.name: get_students
methods.description: Fetches and adds students to the group based on selected criteria.

methods.name: instructors_add
methods.description: Defines query for selecting instructors, excluding already added ones.
